summary: In the United States, Emtricitabine carries a boxed warning, which is the strongest warning from the FDA, for liver harm and severe flare-ups of hepatitis B (a viral liver infection) after stopping treatment [3][6]. Additional warnings for the drug include kidney problems and immune reconstitution syndrome, a condition where the recovering immune system causes new reactions [6]. One clinical study also noted high increases in liver function test levels [9]. Additionally, a small computer model, not tests on people, calculated a high score of 90 for liver risk and a low score of 14 for heart risk [M].
